hypotheses.persona: Standard working adult with a dog
hypotheses.rationale: Weekday routine (morning walk, midday meal, evening return) remains consistent. Sunday morning coffee and evening relaxation (blanket) fit a standard work-life balance pattern. No evidence contradicts this.

Still possible if work is done in unobserved areas, but lack of work devices and strict 9-5-like movement patterns make this unlikely. Sunday blanket usage could imply leisure, but doesn't strongly support WFH over standard worker.
Contradicted by consistent early morning and late afternoon activity patterns across multiple days.
